```{r}

#Trial demographics

data <- read_excel("Withdawl_final1.xlsx", 
    col_types = c("numeric", "text", "text", 
        "text", "text", "text", "text", "text", 
        "text", "text", "text", "text", "text", 
        "text", "text", "numeric", "numeric", 
        "numeric", "text", "text", "text", 
        "text", "text", "text", "text", "text", 
        "numeric", "numeric", "numeric", 
        "numeric", "text", "text", "text", 
        "text", "text", "text", "numeric", 
        "text", "text", "numeric", "numeric", 
        "numeric", "numeric", "numeric", 
        "numeric", "numeric", "numeric", 
        "numeric", "numeric", "numeric", 
        "numeric", "numeric", "numeric", 
        "numeric", "numeric", "numeric"))

# Continuous Variables: Convert Follow up period (years) to months
data <- data %>%
  mutate(`Follow up period (years)` = as.numeric(gsub("[^0-9.]", "", `Follow up period (years)`)))

# Continuous variable summary
continuous_summary <- data %>%
  mutate(`Follow up period (months)` = `Follow up period (years)` * 12) %>%
  summarize(
    `Follow up period (months)` = paste0(
      median(`Follow up period (months)`, na.rm = TRUE), " (", 
      IQR(`Follow up period (months)`, na.rm = TRUE), ")"
    ),
    `Number enrolled in trial` = paste0(
      sum(`Number enrolled in trial`, na.rm = TRUE), " (", 
      median(`Number enrolled in trial`, na.rm = TRUE), ")"
    )  # Include sum (median) for Number enrolled
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = everything(), names_to = "Characteristic", values_to = "Value")

# Categorical Variables: Update column names and handle missing columns
categorical_columns <- c(
  "Randomized? (y/n)", 
  "Study type", 
  "Control group", 
  "Type of drug control", 
  "Mono or combo therapy in control arm", 
  "Type of drug interventional", 
  "Mono or combo therapy in interventional arm", 
  "Subtype",
  "Blinding practice", 
  "Lines of treatment", 
  "Disease status", 
  "Sponser", 
  "Location of trial", 
  "Primary endpoint of trials"
)

# Filter only columns that exist in `data`
categorical_columns <- categorical_columns[categorical_columns %in% colnames(data)]

# Generate a summary for each categorical column
categorical_summary <- lapply(categorical_columns, function(column) {
  if (!is.null(data[[column]]) && length(unique(data[[column]])) > 0) {
    # Create the summary table
    df <- as.data.frame(table(data[[column]]))
    colnames(df) <- c("Category", "Count")
    df$Percentage <- round((df$Count / sum(df$Count)) * 100, 1)
    df$Characteristic <- column
    df$Value <- paste0(df$Category, ": ", df$Count, " (", df$Percentage, "%)")
    return(df[, c("Characteristic", "Value")])
  } else {
    # Return an empty data frame if the column is missing or empty
    return(data.frame(Characteristic = column, Value = "No data available"))
  }
})

# Combine into a single data frame
categorical_summary_df <- do.call(rbind, categorical_summary)

# Combine Continuous and Categorical Summaries
table_1_df <- bind_rows(continuous_summary, categorical_summary_df)

# Export combined summary to Excel
write_xlsx(list(
  "Table 1" = table_1_df
), path = "Table_1_Characteristics.xlsx")

# Display the final table
print(table_1_df)




```

```{r}


#Table 2, withdrawl reasons

# Load necessary libraries
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(writexl)
library(stats)

# Define relevant column names
withdrawal_columns <- c(
  "Number withdrew from treatment arm(s)",
  "Number withdrew from treatment arm(s) due to adverse event",
  "Number withdrew from treatment arm(s) due to progression of disease",
  "Number withdrew from treatment arm(s) due patient withdrawl of consent",
  "Number withdrew from control arm",
  "Number withdrew from control arm due to adverse event",
  "Number withdrew from control arm due to progression of dz",
  "Number withdrew from control arm due patient withdrawl of consent"
)

randomization_columns <- c(
  "Number randomized (or selected)  to treatment arm(s)",
  "Number randomized (or selected)  to control arm"
)

# Clean and convert all relevant columns in a single step
data <- data %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(c(withdrawal_columns, randomization_columns)), ~ as.numeric(gsub("[^0-9.]", "", .))))

# Calculate totals
total_randomized_treatment <- sum(data$`Number randomized (or selected)  to treatment arm(s)`, na.rm = TRUE)
total_randomized_control <- sum(data$`Number randomized (or selected)  to control arm`, na.rm = TRUE)
total_enrolled <- total_randomized_treatment + total_randomized_control

# Create summary data
summary_data <- data.frame(
  Reason = c(
    "Overall withdrawal",
    "Due to adverse event",
    "Due to progression of disease",
    "Due to patient withdrawal of consent",
    "Discontinuation rate"
  ),
  Treatment_Count = c(
    sum(data$`Number withdrew from treatment arm(s)`, na.rm = TRUE),
    sum(data$`Number withdrew from treatment arm(s) due to adverse event`, na.rm = TRUE),
    sum(data$`Number withdrew from treatment arm(s) due to progression of disease`, na.rm = TRUE),
    sum(data$`Number withdrew from treatment arm(s) due patient withdrawl of consent`, na.rm = TRUE),
    sum(data$`Number withdrew from treatment arm(s)`, na.rm = TRUE) -
      (sum(data$`Number withdrew from treatment arm(s) due to adverse event`, na.rm = TRUE) +
       sum(data$`Number withdrew from treatment arm(s) due to progression of disease`, na.rm = TRUE) +
       sum(data$`Number withdrew from treatment arm(s) due patient withdrawl of consent`, na.rm = TRUE))
  ),
  Control_Count = c(
    sum(data$`Number withdrew from control arm`, na.rm = TRUE),
    sum(data$`Number withdrew from control arm due to adverse event`, na.rm = TRUE),
    sum(data$`Number withdrew from control arm due to progression of dz`, na.rm = TRUE),
    sum(data$`Number withdrew from control arm due patient withdrawl of consent`, na.rm = TRUE),
    sum(data$`Number withdrew from control arm`, na.rm = TRUE) -
      (sum(data$`Number withdrew from control arm due to adverse event`, na.rm = TRUE) +
       sum(data$`Number withdrew from control arm due to progression of dz`, na.rm = TRUE) +
       sum(data$`Number withdrew from control arm due patient withdrawl of consent`, na.rm = TRUE))
  )
)

# Add percentages and p-values
summary_data <- summary_data %>%
  mutate(
    `Treatment Count (%)` = paste0(Treatment_Count, " (", round((Treatment_Count / total_randomized_treatment) * 100, 2), "%)"),
    `Control Count (%)` = paste0(Control_Count, " (", round((Control_Count / total_randomized_control) * 100, 2), "%)"),
    `Total Count (%)` = paste0(Treatment_Count + Control_Count, " (", round(((Treatment_Count + Control_Count) / total_enrolled) * 100, 2), "%)"),
    p_value = sapply(1:nrow(summary_data), function(i) {
      treatment_count <- Treatment_Count[i]
      control_count <- Control_Count[i]
      contingency_table <- matrix(c(treatment_count, total_randomized_treatment - treatment_count,
                                    control_count, total_randomized_control - control_count), nrow = 2)
      if (all(contingency_table > 0)) {
        chisq.test(contingency_table)$p.value
      } else {
        NA
      }
    })
  )

# Select final columns and write to Excel
summary_output <- summary_data %>%
  select(Reason, `Total Count (%)`, `Treatment Count (%)`, `Control Count (%)`, p_value)

write_xlsx(summary_output, "Withdrawal_Summary_with_Discontinuation_and_P_Values.xlsx")

# Display final table
summary_output

```

```{r}

#Figure 1
# Load necessary libraries


# Load the data
file_path <- "Cleaned_Clinical_Trial_Data.xlsx"
Cleaned_Clinical_Trial_Data <- read_excel(file_path)

# Define the columns of interest
columns_of_interest <- c(
    "Total_Withdrawl/Discontinuation",
    "Total_Withdrawl_Of_Patient_Consent_W/O_Clear_Reasons",
    "Total_Withdrawl_Due_To_Trae",
    "Total_Withdrew_Due_To_Progression_Of_Dz",
    "Total_Withdrawl_Due_To_Complicating_Medical_Disease",
    "Total_Withdrawl__To_Seek_Alternative_Tx",
    "Total_Investigator_Initated_Withdrawl_Due_To_No_Longer_Meeting_Study_Eligibility_Criteria",
    "Withdrew_By_Sponser_Due_To_Non-Compliance",
    "Withdrew_Due_To_Death",
    "Unspecified_Loss_To_F/U",
    "Total_N_For_Other_Reasonsof_Withdrawl"
)

# Convert columns of interest to numeric, coercing non-numeric values to NA
Cleaned_Clinical_Trial_Data[columns_of_interest] <- Cleaned_Clinical_Trial_Data[columns_of_interest] %>%
    mutate(across(everything(), ~ as.numeric(.)))

# Calculate overall withdrawal
overall_withdrawal <- sum(Cleaned_Clinical_Trial_Data[["Total_Withdrawl/Discontinuation"]], na.rm = TRUE)

# Combine rows as requested
other_total <- sum(
    Cleaned_Clinical_Trial_Data[["Total_N_For_Other_Reasonsof_Withdrawl"]], 
    Cleaned_Clinical_Trial_Data[["Total_Withdrawl_Due_To_Complicating_Medical_Disease"]], 
    Cleaned_Clinical_Trial_Data[["Total_Withdrawl__To_Seek_Alternative_Tx"]],
    na.rm = TRUE
)

trial_driven_total <- sum(
    Cleaned_Clinical_Trial_Data[["Total_Investigator_Initated_Withdrawl_Due_To_No_Longer_Meeting_Study_Eligibility_Criteria"]],
    Cleaned_Clinical_Trial_Data[["Withdrew_By_Sponser_Due_To_Non-Compliance"]],
    na.rm = TRUE
)

# Update combined rows
other_total <- sum(
    Cleaned_Clinical_Trial_Data[["Total_Withdrawl_Due_To_Complicating_Medical_Disease"]], 
    Cleaned_Clinical_Trial_Data[["Total_Withdrawl__To_Seek_Alternative_Tx"]],
    na.rm = TRUE
)

# Updated summary table
summary_data <- data.frame(
    Reason = c(
        "Overall withdrawal",
        "Withdrawal of patient consent w/o clear reasons",
        "Withdrawal due to TRAE",
        "Withdrawal due to progression of disease",
        "Other",  # Combined rows 32, 33
        "Investigator-initiated withdrawal due to ineligibility",  # Row 34
        "Sponsor-initiated withdrawal due to non-compliance",      # Row 35
        "Withdrawal due to death",
        "Unspecified loss to follow-up"
    ),
    Total_Count = c(
        overall_withdrawal,
        sum(Cleaned_Clinical_Trial_Data[["Total_Withdrawl_Of_Patient_Consent_W/O_Clear_Reasons"]], na.rm = TRUE),
        sum(Cleaned_Clinical_Trial_Data[["Total_Withdrawl_Due_To_Trae"]], na.rm = TRUE),
        sum(Cleaned_Clinical_Trial_Data[["Total_Withdrew_Due_To_Progression_Of_Dz"]], na.rm = TRUE),
        other_total,  # Combined total
        sum(Cleaned_Clinical_Trial_Data[["Total_Investigator_Initated_Withdrawl_Due_To_No_Longer_Meeting_Study_Eligibility_Criteria"]], na.rm = TRUE),
        sum(Cleaned_Clinical_Trial_Data[["Withdrew_By_Sponser_Due_To_Non-Compliance"]], na.rm = TRUE),
        sum(Cleaned_Clinical_Trial_Data[["Withdrew_Due_To_Death"]], na.rm = TRUE),
        sum(Cleaned_Clinical_Trial_Data[["Unspecified_Loss_To_F/U"]], na.rm = TRUE)
    )
)

# Recalculate percentages
summary_data <- summary_data %>%
    mutate(Percentage = round((Total_Count / overall_withdrawal) * 100, 2))

# Simulate error bars (replace with actual standard error if available)
summary_data <- summary_data %>%
    mutate(Error = Percentage * 0.02)  # ±2% of the percentage as an example

# Save the updated summary table to an Excel file
write_xlsx(summary_data, "Withdrawal_Summary_Updated.xlsx")

# Re-plot the data excluding "Overall withdrawal"
graph_data <- summary_data %>%
    filter(Reason != "Overall withdrawal") %>%
    arrange(desc(Percentage))

ggplot(graph_data, aes(x = reorder(Reason, -Percentage), y = Percentage, fill = Reason)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity", color = "black") +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = Percentage - Error, ymax = Percentage + Error), width = 0.2) +
    labs(
        title = "Reasons for Withdrawal as Percentage of Overall Withdrawal",
        x = "Reason",
        y = "Percentage (%)"
    ) +
    expand_limits(y = max(graph_data$Percentage + graph_data$Error) + 5) +  # Extend y-axis
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1), legend.position = "none")

# Combine specific withdrawal reasons
graph_data <- summary_data %>%
    filter(Reason != "Overall withdrawal") %>%
    mutate(
        Reason = case_when(
            Reason %in% c(
                "Withdrawal of patient consent w/o clear reasons",
                "Sponsor-initiated withdrawal due to non-compliance",
                "Unspecified loss to follow-up"
            ) ~ "Combined: Withdrawal w/o clear reason, non-compliance, and loss to follow-up",
            TRUE ~ Reason
        )
    ) %>%
    group_by(Reason) %>%
    summarise(
        Total_Count = sum(Total_Count, na.rm = TRUE),
        Percentage = sum(Percentage, na.rm = TRUE),
        Error = sum(Error, na.rm = TRUE)
    ) %>%
    arrange(desc(Percentage))

# Re-plot the data with combined bars
ggplot(graph_data, aes(x = reorder(Reason, -Percentage), y = Percentage, fill = Reason)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity", color = "black") +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = Percentage - Error, ymax = Percentage + Error), width = 0.2) +
    labs(
        title = "Reasons for Withdrawal as Percentage of Overall Withdrawal",
        x = "Reason",
        y = "Percentage (%)"
    ) +
    expand_limits(y = max(graph_data$Percentage + graph_data$Error) + 5) +  # Extend y-axis
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1), legend.position = "none")

# Rename and reorder the bars
graph_data <- graph_data %>%
    mutate(
        Reason = factor(Reason, levels = c(
            "Withdrawal due to progression of disease",
            "Withdrawal due to death",
            "Combined: Withdrawal w/o clear reason, non-compliance, and loss to follow-up",
            "Withdrawal due to TRAE",
            "Investigator-initiated withdrawal due to ineligibility",
            "Other"
        )),
        Custom_Labels = c("POD", "Death", "Unclear", "TRAE", "Ineligibility", "Other")
    ) %>%
    arrange(Reason)

# Re-plot the data with renamed and reordered bars
ggplot(graph_data, aes(x = Reason, y = Percentage, fill = Reason)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity", color = "black") +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = Percentage - Error, ymax = Percentage + Error), width = 0.2) +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = graph_data$Custom_Labels) +  # Apply custom labels
    labs(
        title = "Reasons for Withdrawal as Percentage of Overall Withdrawal",
        x = "Reason",
        y = "Percentage (%)"
    ) +
    expand_limits(y = max(graph_data$Percentage + graph_data$Error) + 5) +  # Extend y-axis
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1), legend.position = "none")
```

```{r}

#Reasons for attirtion with subgroup analysis by tumor type and dz status

# Load necessary libraries
library(dplyr)
library(writexl)

# Define the specified columns for conversion
columns_to_convert <- c(
  "Total withdrawl of patient consent w/o clear reasons",
  "Total withdrawl due to TRAE (tx adverse effects",
  "Total withdrew due to progression of dz",
  "Total withdrawl due to complicating medical disease",
  "Total investigator initated withdrawl due to no longer meeting study eligibility criteria",
  "Withdrew by sponser due to non-compliance",
  "Withdrew due to death",
  "Unspecified loss to f/u",
  "Total N for other reasonsof withdrawl",
  "Number withdrew from control arm due to adverse event",
  "Number withdrew from control arm due to progression of dz",
  "Number withdrew from control arm due patient withdrawl of consent",
  "Number randomized (or selected)  to control arm",
  "Number withdrew from treatment arm(s) due to adverse event",
  "Number withdrew from treatment arm(s) due to progression of disease",
  "Number withdrew from treatment arm(s) due patient withdrawl of consent",
  "Number randomized (or selected)  to treatment arm(s)"
)

# Convert columns to numeric if they exist in data
columns_to_convert <- columns_to_convert[columns_to_convert %in% colnames(data)]
data[columns_to_convert] <- lapply(data[columns_to_convert], function(x) as.numeric(as.character(x)))

# Function to calculate withdrawal summary with count and percentage
calculate_withdrawal_summary <- function(data) {
  # Total withdrawals and enrolled
  total_withdrawals <- sum(data$`Total withdrawl/discontinuation`, na.rm = TRUE)
  total_enrolled <- sum(data$`Number enrolled in trial`, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  # Summarize each reason for withdrawal with counts and percentages
  summary_table <- data %>%
    summarize(
      `Total Withdrawl consent` = paste0(sum(`Total withdrawl of patient consent w/o clear reasons`, na.rm = TRUE), " (", 
                                         round(sum(`Total withdrawl of patient consent w/o clear reasons`, na.rm = TRUE) / total_withdrawals * 100, 1), "%)"),
      `Total withdrawl due to TRAE` = paste0(sum(`Total withdrawl due to TRAE (tx adverse effects`, na.rm = TRUE), " (", 
                                                 round(sum(`Total withdrawl due to TRAE (tx adverse effects`, na.rm = TRUE) / total_withdrawals * 100, 1), "%)"),
      `Total withdrew due to progression of dz` = paste0(sum(`Total withdrew due to progression of dz`, na.rm = TRUE), " (", 
                                                        round(sum(`Total withdrew due to progression of dz`, na.rm = TRUE) / total_withdrawals * 100, 1), "%)"),
      `Total withdrawl due to complicating medical disease` = paste0(sum(`Total withdrawl due to complicating medical disease`, na.rm = TRUE), " (", 
                                                                     round(sum(`Total withdrawl due to complicating medical disease`, na.rm = TRUE) / total_withdrawals * 100, 1), "%)"),
      `Total investigator initiated withdrawl` = paste0(sum(`Total investigator initated withdrawl due to no longer meeting study eligibility criteria`, na.rm = TRUE), " (", 
                                                       round(sum(`Total investigator initated withdrawl due to no longer meeting study eligibility criteria`, na.rm = TRUE) / total_withdrawals * 100, 1), "%)"),
      `Withdrew by sponsor due to non-compliance` = paste0(sum(`Withdrew by sponser due to non-compliance`, na.rm = TRUE), " (", 
                                                          round(sum(`Withdrew by sponser due to non-compliance`, na.rm = TRUE) / total_withdrawals * 100, 1), "%)"),
      `Withdrew due to death` = paste0(sum(`Withdrew due to death`, na.rm = TRUE), " (", 
                                       round(sum(`Withdrew due to death`, na.rm = TRUE) / total_withdrawals * 100, 1), "%)"),
      `Unspecified loss to follow-up` = paste0(sum(`Unspecified loss to f/u`, na.rm = TRUE), " (", 
                                               round(sum(`Unspecified loss to f/u`, na.rm = TRUE) / total_withdrawals * 100, 1), "%)"),
      `Total N for other reasons` = paste0(sum(`Total N for other reasonsof withdrawl`, na.rm = TRUE), " (", 
                                           round(sum(`Total N for other reasonsof withdrawl`, na.rm = TRUE) / total_withdrawals * 100, 1), "%)"),
      `Discontinuation Rate` = paste0(total_withdrawals, " (", round((total_withdrawals / total_enrolled) * 100, 1), "%)"),
      
      # Control arm withdrawal percentages with count
      `% withdrew from control arm due to adverse event` = paste0(sum(`Number withdrew from control arm due to adverse event`, na.rm = TRUE), " (", 
                                                                  round(sum(`Number withdrew from control arm due to adverse event`, na.rm = TRUE) / sum(`Number randomized (or selected)  to control arm`, na.rm = TRUE) * 100, 1), "%)"),
      `% withdrew from control arm due to progression of dz` = paste0(sum(`Number withdrew from control arm due to progression of dz`, na.rm = TRUE), " (", 
                                                                     round(sum(`Number withdrew from control arm due to progression of dz`, na.rm = TRUE) / sum(`Number randomized (or selected)  to control arm`, na.rm = TRUE) * 100, 1), "%)"),
      `% withdrew from control arm due patient withdrawl of consent` = paste0(sum(`Number withdrew from control arm due patient withdrawl of consent`, na.rm = TRUE), " (", 
                                                                             round(sum(`Number withdrew from control arm due patient withdrawl of consent`, na.rm = TRUE) / sum(`Number randomized (or selected)  to control arm`, na.rm = TRUE) * 100, 1), "%)"),
      
      # Interventional arm withdrawal percentages with count
      `% withdrew from interventional arm due to adverse event` = paste0(sum(`Number withdrew from treatment arm(s) due to adverse event`, na.rm = TRUE), " (", 
                                                                        round(sum(`Number withdrew from treatment arm(s) due to adverse event`, na.rm = TRUE) / sum(`Number randomized (or selected)  to treatment arm(s)`, na.rm = TRUE) * 100, 1), "%)"),
      `% withdrew from interventional arm due to progression of dz` = paste0(sum(`Number withdrew from treatment arm(s) due to progression of disease`, na.rm = TRUE), " (", 
                                                                            round(sum(`Number withdrew from treatment arm(s) due to progression of disease`, na.rm = TRUE) / sum(`Number randomized (or selected)  to treatment arm(s)`, na.rm = TRUE) * 100, 1), "%)"),
      `% withdrew from interventional arm due patient withdrawl of consent` = paste0(sum(`Number withdrew from treatment arm(s) due patient withdrawl of consent`, na.rm = TRUE), " (", 
                                                                                     round(sum(`Number withdrew from treatment arm(s) due patient withdrawl of consent`, na.rm = TRUE) / sum(`Number randomized (or selected)  to treatment arm(s)`, na.rm = TRUE) * 100, 1), "%)")
    )
  
  return(summary_table)
}

# Step 1: Perform non-subgroup analysis with discontinuation rate
non_subgroup_summary <- calculate_withdrawal_summary(data)

# Step 2: Subgroup analysis by disease status and tumor type
subgroup_disease_status <- data %>%
    group_by(`Disease status`) %>%
    do(calculate_withdrawal_summary(.)) %>%
    ungroup()

subgroup_tumor_type <- data %>%
    group_by(`Subtype`) %>%
    do(calculate_withdrawal_summary(.)) %>%
    ungroup()

# Export all summaries to Excel
write_xlsx(list(
  "Non-subgroup Summary" = non_subgroup_summary,
  "By Disease Status" = subgroup_disease_status,
  "By Tumor Type (Subtype)" = subgroup_tumor_type
), path = "Withdrawal_Summary_with_Discontinuation_Rate.xlsx")


```

```{r}
#Descriptive analysis for mitigation practices

# Load necessary libraries
library(dplyr)
library(writexl)


# Define the specified columns
specified_columns <- c(
  "contact patients lost to f/u", "encouragement", "home nursing", 
  "no mitigation stratigies", "patient education", "protocol amendments", 
  "supportive care", "telemedicine", "Non-specific effort", 
  "Unblinding or cross-over", "Dosing or schedule adjustments", 
  "Continued tx after withdrawl or re-challenge"
)

# Calculate count and percentage for each specified column
summary_table <- data %>%
  summarize(across(all_of(specified_columns), ~ sum(.x, na.rm = TRUE))) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = everything(), names_to = "Reason", values_to = "Count")

# Calculate total count to use for percentage calculation
total_count <- sum(summary_table$Count, na.rm = TRUE)

# Add percentage and format the output as "count (percentage%)"
summary_table <- summary_table %>%
  mutate(Percentage = round((Count / total_count) * 100, 1),
         Value = paste0(Count, " (", Percentage, "%)")) %>%
  select(Reason, Value)

# Display the summary table for verification
print("Summary table for specified columns:")
print(summary_table)

# Export to Excel
write_xlsx(summary_table, "Specified_Columns_Summary.xlsx")
```

```{r}

#Mitigation practice graph

# Load necessary libraries
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(writexl)
library(ggplot2)

# Define the specified columns
specified_columns <- c(
  "contact patients lost to f/u", "encouragement", "home nursing", 
  "no mitigation stratigies", "patient education", "protocol amendments", 
  "supportive care", "telemedicine", "Non-specific effort", 
  "Unblinding or cross-over", "Dosing or schedule adjustments", 
  "Continued tx after withdrawl or re-challenge"
)

# Calculate count and percentage for each specified column
summary_table <- data %>%
  summarize(across(all_of(specified_columns), ~ sum(.x, na.rm = TRUE))) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = everything(), names_to = "Reason", values_to = "Count")

# Calculate total count to use for percentage calculation
total_count <- sum(summary_table$Count, na.rm = TRUE)

# Add percentage and confidence intervals
summary_table <- summary_table %>%
  mutate(
    Percentage = round((Count / total_count) * 100, 1),
    Lower_CI = pmax(0, round(((Count / total_count) - 1.96 * sqrt((Count / total_count) * (1 - (Count / total_count)) / total_count)) * 100, 1)),
    Upper_CI = pmin(100, round(((Count / total_count) + 1.96 * sqrt((Count / total_count) * (1 - (Count / total_count)) / total_count)) * 100, 1))
  )

# Combine rows with percentages less than 3% into "Other"
summary_table <- summary_table %>%
  mutate(
    Reason = ifelse(Percentage < 3, "Other", Reason)
  ) %>%
  group_by(Reason) %>%
  summarise(
    Count = sum(Count, na.rm = TRUE),
    Percentage = round((Count / total_count) * 100, 1),
    Lower_CI = pmax(0, round(((Count / total_count) - 1.96 * sqrt((Count / total_count) * (1 - (Count / total_count)) / total_count)) * 100, 1)),
    Upper_CI = pmin(100, round(((Count / total_count) + 1.96 * sqrt((Count / total_count) * (1 - (Count / total_count)) / total_count)) * 100, 1))
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Percentage))

# Export the updated summary table to Excel
write_xlsx(summary_table, "Specified_Columns_Summary_Updated_with_CI.xlsx")

# Plot a bar chart with 95% confidence intervals
# Plot a bar chart with 95% confidence intervals
ggplot(summary_table, aes(x = reorder(Reason, -Percentage), y = Percentage, fill = Reason)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", color = "black") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = Lower_CI, ymax = Upper_CI), width = 0.2) +
  labs(
    title = "Mitigation Practices as Percentage of Total (95% CI)",
    x = "Mitigation Practice",
    y = "Percentage (%)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    legend.position = "none"  # Remove legend
  )
```

```{r}
#Regression mitigation for unclear follow up

# Load necessary libraries
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(mgcv)
library(openxlsx)

# Read and clean the data
file_path <- "Rodrigo_Clean_data.xlsx"
Cleaned_Clinical_Trial_Data <- read_excel(file_path, sheet = "Sheet1") %>%
  na.omit() %>%
  mutate(
    treatment_lines = as.factor(treatment_lines),
    tx_group_drug = as.factor(tx_group_drug),
    sponsors = as.factor(sponsors),
    disease_status = factor(disease_status,
                            levels = c("5", "1", "2", "3", "4"),
                            labels = c("Treatment_Naive", "Advanced_Metastatic",
                                       "Progressive_Disease", "Remission", "Residual"))
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    non_compliance = ifelse(
      total_number_enrolled > 0,
      (total_withdrew_noreason + total_withdrew_because_noncompliance + lost_fu) / total_number_enrolled,
      NA
    ),
    death_rate = ifelse(
      total_number_enrolled > 0,
      total_withdrew_because_death / total_number_enrolled,
      NA
    ),
    TRAE_rate = ifelse(
      total_number_withdrew > 0,
      total_withdrew_because_ae / total_number_withdrew,
      NA
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(non_compliance), !is.na(death_rate))  # Ensure no missing values

# Define the GAM fitting and summarization function with corrected column names
fit_gam_and_summarize <- function(outcome_column_name, dataset, output_file = NULL) {
  # Verify if the outcome column exists
  if (!(outcome_column_name %in% colnames(dataset))) {
    stop(paste("The outcome column", outcome_column_name, "is not found in the dataset."))
  }
  
  # Select relevant columns dynamically
  regression_data <- dataset %>%
    select(
      all_of(outcome_column_name),
      mitigation_contact,
      mitigation_encouragment,
      mitigation_nursing,
      mitigation_patienteducation,
      mitigation_protocolamend,
      mitigation_supportivecare,
      mitigation_telemedicine,
      mitigation_crossover,
      mitigation_dosingadjustment,
      mitigation_txafterwithdrawl
    ) %>%
    drop_na()  # Remove rows with NA
  
  # Fit the GAM model
  gam_model <- gam(
    formula = as.formula(paste(outcome_column_name, "~ 
                                mitigation_contact + 
                                mitigation_encouragment + 
                                mitigation_nursing + 
                                mitigation_patienteducation + 
                                mitigation_protocolamend + 
                                mitigation_supportivecare + 
                                mitigation_telemedicine + 
                                mitigation_crossover + 
                                mitigation_dosingadjustment + 
                                mitigation_txafterwithdrawl")),
    data = regression_data,
    family = binomial()
  )
  
  # Summarize the model
  summary_df <- as.data.frame(summary(gam_model)$p.table)
  summary_df <- cbind(term = rownames(summary_df), summary_df)
  rownames(summary_df) <- NULL  # Reset row names
  summary_df <- summary_df %>% mutate(across(where(is.numeric), round, 3))  # Round numeric columns to 3 decimal places
  
  # Export results to Excel if output_file is provided
  if (!is.null(output_file)) {
    wb <- createWorkbook()
    addWorksheet(wb, "GAM_Summary")
    writeData(wb, "GAM_Summary", summary_df)
    saveWorkbook(wb, output_file, overwrite = TRUE)
  }
  
  # Return summary and coefficients
  list(
    summary = summary_df,
    coefficients = data.frame(
      term = names(coef(gam_model)),
      estimate = round(coef(gam_model), 3)  # Round coefficients to 3 decimal places
    )
  )
}

# Re-run the model with non_compliance as the outcome
output_file <- "GAM_Model_Summary_Non_Compliance.xlsx"
results_non_compliance <- fit_gam_and_summarize("non_compliance", Cleaned_Clinical_Trial_Data, output_file)

# Print success message and preview summary
cat("GAM model summary for non-compliance exported to:", output_file, "\n")
print(results_non_compliance$summary)

                            labels = c("Treatment_Naive", "Advanced_Metastatic",
                                       "Progressive_Disease", "Remission", "Residual"))
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    non_compliance = ifelse(
      total_number_enrolled > 0,
      (total_withdrew_noreason + total_withdrew_because_noncompliance + lost_fu) / total_number_enrolled,
      NA
    ),
    death_rate = ifelse(
      total_number_enrolled > 0,
      total_withdrew_because_death / total_number_enrolled,
      NA
    ),
    TRAE_rate = ifelse(
      total_number_withdrew > 0,
      total_withdrew_because_ae / total_number_withdrew,
      NA
    )

# Define the linear regression function
fit_linear_regression <- function(outcome_column_name, dataset, output_file = NULL) {
  # Verify if the outcome column exists
  if (!(outcome_column_name %in% colnames(dataset))) {
    stop(paste("The outcome column", outcome_column_name, "is not found in the dataset."))
  }
  
  # Select relevant columns dynamically
  regression_data <- dataset %>%
    select(
      all_of(outcome_column_name),
      mitigation_contact,
      mitigation_encouragment,
      mitigation_nursing,
      mitigation_patienteducation,
      mitigation_protocolamend,
      mitigation_supportivecare,
      mitigation_telemedicine,
      mitigation_crossover,
      mitigation_dosingadjustment,
      mitigation_txafterwithdrawl
    ) %>%
    drop_na()  # Remove rows with NA
  
  # Fit the linear regression model
  formula <- as.formula(paste(outcome_column_name, "~ 
                                mitigation_contact + 
                                mitigation_encouragment + 
                                mitigation_nursing + 
                                mitigation_patienteducation + 
                                mitigation_protocolamend + 
                                mitigation_supportivecare + 
                                mitigation_telemedicine + 
                                mitigation_crossover + 
                                mitigation_dosingadjustment + 
                                mitigation_txafterwithdrawl"))
  linear_model <- lm(formula, data = regression_data)
  
  # Summarize the model
  summary_df <- as.data.frame(summary(linear_model)$coefficients)
  summary_df <- cbind(term = rownames(summary_df), summary_df)
  rownames(summary_df) <- NULL  # Reset row names
  summary_df <- summary_df %>% mutate(across(where(is.numeric), round, 3))  # Round numeric columns to 3 decimal places
  
  # Export results to Excel if output_file is provided
  if (!is.null(output_file)) {
    wb <- createWorkbook()
    addWorksheet(wb, "Linear_Regression_Summary")
    writeData(wb, "Linear_Regression_Summary", summary_df)
    saveWorkbook(wb, output_file, overwrite = TRUE)
  }
  
  # Return summary and coefficients
  list(
    summary = summary_df,
    coefficients = data.frame(
      term = names(coef(linear_model)),
      estimate = round(coef(linear_model), 3)  # Round coefficients to 3 decimal places
    )
  )
}

# Run the model with non_compliance as the outcome
```

```{r}

#Univariate analysis

# Load required libraries
library(dplyr)
library(ggpubr)
library(readxl)

# Set working directory and file path
setwd("~/R")
file_path <- "Rodrigo_Clean_data.xlsx"

# Read data, remove missing values, and convert specified columns to factors
data_cleaned <- read_excel(file_path, sheet = "Sheet1") %>%
  na.omit() %>%
  mutate(
    blinding_practice = as.factor(blinding_practice),
    treatment_lines = as.factor(treatment_lines),
    disease_status = as.factor(disease_status),
    sponsors = as.factor(sponsors),
    trial_location = as.factor(trial_location),
    site_number = as.factor(site_number),
    randomization = as.factor(randomization), Subtype=as.factor(Subtype)  # Convert randomization to factor
  )

data_cleaned$disease_status <- factor(data_cleaned$disease_status,
                                      levels = c("1", "2", "3", "4", "5"),
                                      labels = c("Advanced_Metastatic", 
                                                 "Progressive_Disease", 
                                                 "Remission", 
                                                 "Residual", 
                                                 "Treatment_Naive"))

# Create derived variables: non_compliance, death_rate, and TRAE_rate
data_cleaned <- data_cleaned %>%
  mutate(
    non_compliance = ifelse(
      total_number_enrolled > 0,
      (total_withdrew_noreason + total_withdrew_because_noncompliance + lost_fu) / total_number_enrolled,
      NA
    ),
    death_rate = ifelse(
      total_number_enrolled > 0,
      total_withdrew_because_death / total_number_enrolled,
      NA
    ),
    TRAE_rate = ifelse(
      total_number_withdrew > 0,
      total_withdrew_because_ae / total_number_withdrew,
      NA
    )
  ) %>%
  # Filter out rows with missing non_compliance or death_rate, rename non_compliance to outcome
  filter(!is.na(non_compliance), !is.na(death_rate)) %>%
  rename(outcome = non_compliance)

# Add a binary variable for unclear follow-up status
data_cleaned <- data_cleaned %>%
  mutate(
    unclear_follow_up_boolean = ifelse(outcome > 0.15, "Above 15%", "15% or Below")
  )

# Rename values in the blinding_practice column and convert control_group to a factor
data_cleaned <- data_cleaned %>%
  mutate(
    blinding_practice = case_when(
      blinding_practice == 1 ~ "patient_blind",
      blinding_practice %in% c(2, 3) ~ "patient_aware",
      TRUE ~ as.character(blinding_practice)
    ),
    control_group = as.factor(control_group)  # Convert control_group to factor
  )

# Define the list of categorical variables (including randomization)
categorical_vars <- c("blinding_practice", "treatment_lines", "disease_status", 
                      "sponsors", "trial_location", "site_number", "control_group", "randomization","Subtype")

# Perform chi-squared or Fisher's exact test depending on expected frequencies
chi_squared_results <- lapply(categorical_vars, function(var) {
  contingency_table <- table(data_cleaned[[var]], data_cleaned$unclear_follow_up_boolean)
  
  # Check if any expected frequency is below 5
  if (any(prop.table(contingency_table) * sum(contingency_table) < 5)) {
    test_result <- fisher.test(contingency_table)  # Use Fisher's exact test
  } else {
    test_result <- chisq.test(contingency_table)  # Use Chi-squared test
  }
  
  return(test_result)
})

# Combine results for categorical variables into a named list
names(chi_squared_results) <- categorical_vars

# Extract p-values and test types from chi_squared_results
categorical_p_values <- data.frame(
  Variable = names(chi_squared_results),
  P_Value = sapply(chi_squared_results, function(result) result$p.value),
  Test_Type = sapply(chi_squared_results, function(result) {
    if ("method" %in% names(result)) {
      result$method
    } else {
      "Unknown"
    }
  }),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
# Perform Wilcoxon rank-sum tests for numeric variables
wilcox_results <- list(
  follow_up = wilcox.test(follow_up_period ~ unclear_follow_up_boolean, data = data_cleaned),
  TRAE_rate = wilcox.test(TRAE_rate ~ unclear_follow_up_boolean, data = data_cleaned),
  death_rate = wilcox.test(death_rate ~ unclear_follow_up_boolean, data = data_cleaned)
)

# Extract Wilcoxon p-values into a data frame
wilcox_p_values <- data.frame(
  Variable = names(wilcox_results),
  P_Value = sapply(wilcox_results, function(result) result$p.value),
  Test_Type = rep("Wilcoxon rank-sum test", length(wilcox_results)),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# Print Wilcoxon test results
cat("Wilcoxon Rank-Sum Test Results:\n")
print(wilcox_p_values)

# Extract p-values and test types from wilcox_results
wilcox_p_values <- data.frame(
  Variable = names(wilcox_results),
  P_Value = sapply(wilcox_results, function(result) result$p.value),
  Test_Type = rep("Wilcoxon rank-sum test", length(wilcox_results)),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# Combine both results into a single table
combined_p_values <- rbind(categorical_p_values, wilcox_p_values)

# Sort table by Variable name for clarity (optional)
combined_p_values <- combined_p_values[order(combined_p_values$Variable), ]

# Display the combined table
print(combined_p_values)

 #Create boxplots for numeric variables
boxplots <- list(
  follow_up = ggboxplot(data_cleaned, x = "unclear_follow_up_boolean", y = "follow_up_period",
                        color = "unclear_follow_up_boolean", title = "Follow-Up Period by Unclear Follow-Up Status",
                        ylab = "Follow-Up Period", xlab = "Unclear Follow-Up Status"),
  TEAEs = ggboxplot(data_cleaned, x = "unclear_follow_up_boolean", y = "TRAE_rate",
                    color = "unclear_follow_up_boolean", title = "TEAEs by Unclear Follow-Up Status",
                    ylab = "TRAEs Rate", xlab = "Unclear Follow-Up Status"),
  deaths = ggboxplot(data_cleaned, x = "unclear_follow_up_boolean", y = "death_rate",
                     color = "unclear_follow_up_boolean", title = "Death Rate by Unclear Follow-Up Status",
                     ylab = "Death Rate", xlab = "Unclear Follow-Up Status")
)

# Display the boxplots after combined table output
lapply(boxplots, print)

# Optionally, write the combined table to an Excel file
library(writexl)
write_xlsx(combined_p_values, "Combined_P_Values.xlsx")
```

```{r}
  theme_minimal()

  geom_point(alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_line(aes(y = predicted_death_rate), color = "green") +
  labs(
    title = "GAM Predictions: Death Rate vs Outcome",
    x = "Death Rate",
    y = "Outcome (Unclear Follow-Up)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
    }
  }),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
# Perform Wilcoxon rank-sum tests for numeric variables
wilcox_results <- list(
  follow_up = wilcox.test(follow_up_period ~ unclear_follow_up_boolean, data = data_cleaned),
  TRAE_rate = wilcox.test(TRAE_rate ~ unclear_follow_up_boolean, data = data_cleaned),
  death_rate = wilcox.test(death_rate ~ unclear_follow_up_boolean, data = data_cleaned)
)

# Extract Wilcoxon p-values into a data frame
wilcox_p_values <- data.frame(
  Variable = names(wilcox_results),
  P_Value = sapply(wilcox_results, function(result) result$p.value),
  Test_Type = rep("Wilcoxon rank-sum test", length(wilcox_results)),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# Print Wilcoxon test results
cat("Wilcoxon Rank-Sum Test Results:\n")
print(wilcox_p_values)

# Extract p-values and test types from wilcox_results
wilcox_p_values <- data.frame(
  Variable = names(wilcox_results),
  P_Value = sapply(wilcox_results, function(result) result$p.value),
  Test_Type = rep("Wilcoxon rank-sum test", length(wilcox_results)),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# Combine both results into a single table
combined_p_values <- rbind(categorical_p_values, wilcox_p_values)

# Sort table by Variable name for clarity (optional)
combined_p_values <- combined_p_values[order(combined_p_values$Variable), ]

# Display the combined table
print(combined_p_values)

 #Create boxplots for numeric variables
boxplots <- list(
  follow_up = ggboxplot(data_cleaned, x = "unclear_follow_up_boolean", y = "follow_up_period",
                        color = "unclear_follow_up_boolean", title = "Follow-Up Period by Unclear Follow-Up Status",
                        ylab = "Follow-Up Period", xlab = "Unclear Follow-Up Status"),
  TEAEs = ggboxplot(data_cleaned, x = "unclear_follow_up_boolean", y = "TRAE_rate",
                    color = "unclear_follow_up_boolean", title = "TEAEs by Unclear Follow-Up Status",
                    ylab = "TRAEs Rate", xlab = "Unclear Follow-Up Status"),
  deaths = ggboxplot(data_cleaned, x = "unclear_follow_up_boolean", y = "death_rate",
                     color = "unclear_follow_up_boolean", title = "Death Rate by Unclear Follow-Up Status",
                     ylab = "Death Rate", xlab = "Unclear Follow-Up Status")
)

# Display the boxplots after combined table output
lapply(boxplots, print)

# Optionally, write the combined table to an Excel file
library(writexl)
write_xlsx(combined_p_values, "Combined_P_Values.xlsx")
```

```{r}
# Linearity Assessment Section

# Libraries needed
library(mgcv)
library(ggplot2)
library(car)
library(lmtest)
library(dplyr)

# Linearity Assessment for follow-up period
ggplot(data_cleaned, aes(x = follow_up_period, y = outcome)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.6) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", color = "blue", linetype = "dashed") +  # Linear fit
    geom_smooth(method = "loess", color = "red") +  # Non-linear LOESS fit
    labs(
        title = "Linearity Assessment: Follow-Up Period vs Outcome",
        x = "Follow-Up Period",
        y = "Outcome (Unclear Follow-Up)"
    ) +
    theme_minimal()

# Interpretation:
# - Visual inspection shows evidence of non-linearity.
# - The red LOESS line deviates from the blue dashed line, indicating a non-linear relationship.

# Fit a GAM for follow-up period
gam_follow_up <- gam(outcome ~ s(follow_up_period, bs = "tp"), data = data_cleaned, family = gaussian())
summary(gam_follow_up)

# Interpretation:
# - The smooth term (s(follow_up_period)) is significant (p = 0.015), indicating non-linearity.
# - Adjusted R-squared (0.028) is low, suggesting limited explanatory power for this predictor.

plot(gam_follow_up, residuals = TRUE, rug = TRUE, main = "GAM for Follow-Up Period")

# Linearity Assessment for death rate
ggplot(data_cleaned, aes(x = death_rate, y = outcome)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.6) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", color = "blue", linetype = "dashed") +  # Linear fit
    geom_smooth(method = "loess", color = "red") +  # Non-linear LOESS fit
    labs(
        title = "Linearity Assessment: Death Rate vs Outcome",
        x = "Death Rate",
        y = "Outcome (Unclear Follow-Up)"
    ) +
    theme_minimal()

# Interpretation:
# - The red LOESS line diverges strongly from the blue dashed line, indicating clear non-linearity.

# Fit a GAM for death rate
gam_death_rate <- gam(outcome ~ s(death_rate, bs = "tp"), data = data_cleaned, family = gaussian())
summary(gam_death_rate)

# Interpretation:
# - The smooth term (s(death_rate)) is highly significant (p < 0.001), confirming non-linearity.
# - Adjusted R-squared (0.0873) is higher than for follow-up period, explaining more variance.

plot(gam_death_rate, residuals = TRUE, rug = TRUE, main = "GAM for Death Rate")

# Multicollinearity Assessment
lm_model <- lm(outcome ~ follow_up_period + death_rate, data = data_cleaned)
vif_results <- vif(lm_model)
print(vif_results)
dev.off()  # Close the current graphics device
# Interpretation:
# - Both predictors have VIF values close to 1, indicating no multicollinearity issues.

# Homoscedasticity Assessment - Residual Plot
ggplot(data_cleaned, aes(x = predict(lm_model), y = residuals(lm_model))) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.6) +
    geom_smooth(method = "loess", color = "red") +
    labs(
        title = "Residuals vs Fitted Values",
        x = "Fitted Values",
        y = "Residuals"
    ) +
    theme_minimal()

# Interpretation:
# - Residuals appear randomly scattered around zero, supporting homoscedasticity.
# - The red LOESS line does not show a clear pattern.

# Breusch-Pagan Test for Homoscedasticity
bp_test <- bptest(lm_model)
print(bp_test)

# Interpretation:
# - The p-value (0.1151) is greater than 0.05, indicating no significant evidence of heteroscedasticity.

# Non-Linearity Assessment using Component-Plus-Residual Plots
crPlots(lm_model)

# Interpretation:
# - The component-plus-residual plots allow visual inspection of non-linearity.
# - Curvature in these plots indicates non-linear relationships for one or both predictors.

# Overall Summary:
# - Linearity: Both predictors show evidence of non-linearity (significant GAM terms and visual assessment).
# - Multicollinearity: No issues detected (low VIF values).
# - Homoscedasticity: Assumption holds (Breusch-Pagan test p-value > 0.05).
# - Recommendation: Consider using non-linear models (e.g., GAMs) or adding non-linear terms to capture the relationships better.
```

```{r}
#Regression

# Set working directory and file path
setwd("~/R")
file_path <- "Rodrigo_Clean_data.xlsx"

# Load necessary libraries
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(mgcv)
library(caret)
library(ggplot2)

# Step 1: Read and clean the data
file_path <- "Rodrigo_Clean_data.xlsx"
data <- read_excel(file_path, sheet = "Sheet1") %>%
  na.omit() %>%
  mutate(
    treatment_lines = as.factor(treatment_lines),
    tx_group_drug = as.factor(tx_group_drug),
    sponsors = as.factor(sponsors),
    disease_status = factor(disease_status,
                            levels = c("5", "1", "2", "3", "4"),
                            labels = c("Treatment_Naive", "Advanced_Metastatic",
                                       "Progressive_Disease", "Remission", "Residual"))
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    non_compliance = ifelse(
      total_number_enrolled > 0,
      (total_withdrew_noreason + total_withdrew_because_noncompliance + lost_fu) / total_number_enrolled,
      NA
    ),
    death_rate = ifelse(
      total_number_enrolled > 0,
      total_withdrew_because_death / total_number_enrolled,
      NA
    ),
    TRAE_rate = ifelse(
      total_number_withdrew > 0,
      total_withdrew_because_ae / total_number_withdrew,
      NA
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(non_compliance), !is.na(death_rate)) %>%
  rename(outcome = non_compliance)

# Step 2: Split the data into 85% train and 15% test
set.seed(123)
train_index <- createDataPartition(data$outcome, p = 0.85, list = FALSE)
train_data <- data[train_index, ]
test_data <- data[-train_index, ]

# Step 3: Fit GAM models
gam_model_full <- gam(
  outcome ~ s(follow_up_period, bs = "tp") + s(death_rate, bs = "tp") +
    s(TRAE_rate, bs = "tp") + TRAE_rate:follow_up_period +
    blinding_practice + disease_status,
  data = train_data,
  family = gaussian(link = "log")
)

gam_model_simplified <- gam(
  outcome ~ s(follow_up_period, bs = "tp") + s(death_rate, bs = "tp")+s(TRAE_rate),
  data = train_data,
  family = gaussian(link = "log")
)

# Step 4: Define helper functions
calculate_r2 <- function(observed, predicted) {
  if (length(observed) != length(predicted)) stop("Observed and predicted lengths do not match.")
  
  ss_residual <- sum((observed - predicted)^2, na.rm = TRUE)
  ss_total <- sum((observed - mean(observed, na.rm = TRUE))^2, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  if (ss_total == 0) return(0)  # Avoid division by zero (if variance is zero)
  
  r2 <- 1 - (ss_residual / ss_total)
  return(max(min(r2, 1), -1))  # Clip R^2 to [-1, 1]
}

calculate_rmse <- function(observed, predicted) {
  sqrt(mean((observed - predicted)^2, na.rm = TRUE))
}

compare_models <- function(model, data, outcome) {
  predicted <- tryCatch(
    predict(model, newdata = data),
    error = function(e) {
      cat("Error in prediction:", e$message, "\n")
      return(rep(NA, nrow(data)))
    }
  )
  if (any(is.na(predicted))) {
    cat("Replacing NA predictions with mean outcome.\n")
    predicted[is.na(predicted)] <- mean(data[[outcome]], na.rm = TRUE)
  }
  predicted <- exp(predicted)
  list(
    R2 = calculate_r2(data[[outcome]], predicted),
    RMSE = calculate_rmse(data[[outcome]], predicted)
  )
}

# Step 5: Calculate results
train_results_full <- compare_models(gam_model_full, train_data, "outcome")
test_results_full <- compare_models(gam_model_full, test_data, "outcome")

train_results_simplified <- compare_models(gam_model_simplified, train_data, "outcome")
test_results_simplified <- compare_models(gam_model_simplified, test_data, "outcome")

# Baseline RMSE
calculate_baseline_rmse <- function(data, outcome_col) {
  baseline_prediction <- mean(data[[outcome_col]])
  sqrt(mean((data[[outcome_col]] - baseline_prediction)^2, na.rm = TRUE))
}

baseline_rmse_train <- calculate_baseline_rmse(train_data, "outcome")
baseline_rmse_test <- calculate_baseline_rmse(test_data, "outcome")

results_comparison <- data.frame(
  Dataset = c("Train", "Test"),
  Full_RMSE = c(train_results_full$RMSE, test_results_full$RMSE),
  Full_R2 = c(train_results_full$R2, test_results_full$R2),
  Simplified_RMSE = c(train_results_simplified$RMSE, test_results_simplified$RMSE),
  Simplified_R2 = c(train_results_simplified$R2, test_results_simplified$R2),
  Baseline_RMSE = c(baseline_rmse_train, baseline_rmse_test)
)

# Step 6: Visualize results
test_data <- test_data %>%
  mutate(
    predicted_outcome_full = exp(predict(gam_model_full, newdata = .)),
    predicted_outcome_simplified = exp(predict(gam_model_simplified, newdata = .))
  )

plot_full <- ggplot(test_data, aes(x = predicted_outcome_full, y = outcome)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7, color = "blue") +
  geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, color = "red", linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(title = "Observed vs Predicted - Full GAM", x = "Predicted", y = "Observed") +
  theme_minimal()

plot_simplified <- ggplot(test_data, aes(x = predicted_outcome_simplified, y = outcome)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7, color = "green") +
  geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, color = "red", linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(title = "Observed vs Predicted - Simplified GAM", x = "Predicted", y = "Observed") +
  theme_minimal()

# Print results and plots
print(results_comparison)
print(plot_full)
print(plot_simplified)

# Summaries of both models
cat("Full Model Summary:\n")
summary(gam_model_full)

cat("\nSimplified Model Summary:\n")
summary(gam_model_simplified)




```
